correctness.rationale: For an unselected cell the exact neighbor count is row occupancy plus column occupancy; the only forbidden one-neighbor support pairs are (1,0) and (0,1). Four exhaustive row/column support cases prove the bound, and inspecting equality classifies every min fort including all exceptional column surjections. Independent original-definition exhaustive script reproduces the formula for 26 boards with 120168 tested candidate subsets and additionally checks the criterion on 10190 subsets. Finite checks do not prove all dimensions; the written proof does.

value.rationale: The bottom layer of the fort hypergraph is a natural obstruction object for zero forcing. On canonical rook products it has a sharp exact all-parameter classification and explicit exceptional rank patterns; its multiplicity grows quartically in the long dimension for two rows and quadratically for any fixed at least three rows. The result gives every minimum certificate, not just a routine minimum-cardinality value or isolated small computation.
